CHROMIUM: iio: cros_ec: Fix Kconfig select rules In commit 72e1ef357ae8 ("CHROMIUM: iio: cros_ec_activity: add activity sensor driver") Activity driver was selecting cros_ec iio core library, while other driver just depends on it. BUG=None TEST=With this change, if no other changes are made in config files, no cros_ec iio driver are selected by ./chromeos/scripts/kernelconfig olddefconfig. Adding IIO_CROS_EC_SENSORS_CORE fixes the problem.
